tours.name: Credit Sales Order - Serial
tours.description: Step-by-step guide to selling a serial-number product to a credit customer on 14 Days payment terms: create the quotation, set the payment type to Credit and the payment terms to 14 Days, confirm it, give the unit its own serial number on the delivery, validate the delivery and invoice the customer. About 14 days later, come back through the Sales app and register the payment. Before you start: you need access to the Sales app, an existing credit customer with no overdue invoices (this guide uses DIDULA MOTORES) and a product tracked by serial number (this guide uses [27PM LJ20] EY20KP PUMP SHAFT ENGINE). A serial number is a unique code that identifies one single unit (like a chassis number), so every unit you deliver needs its own, and it must not be used twice. In every screenshot the red box shows exactly what to click or fill in.

description_i18n.en_US: Step-by-step guide to selling a serial-number product to a credit customer on 14 Days payment terms: create the quotation, set the payment type to Credit and the payment terms to 14 Days, confirm it, give the unit its own serial number on the delivery, validate the delivery and invoice the customer. About 14 days later, come back through the Sales app and register the payment. Before you start: you need access to the Sales app, an existing credit customer with no overdue invoices (this guide uses DIDULA MOTORES) and a product tracked by serial number (this guide uses [27PM LJ20] EY20KP PUMP SHAFT ENGINE). A serial number is a unique code that identifies one single unit (like a chassis number), so every unit you deliver needs its own, and it must not be used twice. In every screenshot the red box shows exactly what to click or fill in.

title_i18n.en_US: Open the sales order

steps.content: Click the order row (red box). The sales order opens.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the order row (red box). The sales order opens.

steps.description: Check: the status bar shows "Sales Order" and an **Invoices** button is at the top.

description_i18n.en_US: Check: the status bar shows "Sales Order" and an **Invoices** button is at the top.

steps.title: Click the Invoices button to open the invoice

title_i18n.en_US: Click the Invoices button to open the invoice

steps.content: At the top of the order, click the **Invoices** button (red box). The posted invoice opens.

content_i18n.en_US: At the top of the order, click the **Invoices** button (red box). The posted invoice opens.

steps.description: Check: the invoice shows the status **Posted**, the Payment Terms **14 Days** and a **Register Payment** button.

description_i18n.en_US: Check: the invoice shows the status **Posted**, the Payment Terms **14 Days** and a **Register Payment** button.

steps.title: Click Register Payment to record the money received

title_i18n.en_US: Click Register Payment to record the money received

steps.content: When the customer pays, click **Register Payment** (red box) at the top of the invoice. A payment window opens.

content_i18n.en_US: When the customer pays, click **Register Payment** (red box) at the top of the invoice. A payment window opens.

steps.description: Why: this records that the customer has paid. For a credit sale this normally happens on or before the 14-day due date. Check: the Register Payment window opens.

description_i18n.en_US: Why: this records that the customer has paid. For a credit sale this normally happens on or before the 14-day due date. Check: the Register Payment window opens.

steps.title: Click the Journal field to choose where the payment is recorded

title_i18n.en_US: Click the Journal field to choose where the payment is recorded

steps.content: Click the **Journal** field at the top left of the window. A short list of journals opens.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the **Journal** field at the top left of the window. A short list of journals opens.

steps.description: Why: the journal decides which account the money goes to: cash, cheque or bank. Check: the list of journals is open.

description_i18n.en_US: Why: the journal decides which account the money goes to: cash, cheque or bank. Check: the list of journals is open.

steps.title: Click Search More... to see all the journals

title_i18n.en_US: Click Search More... to see all the journals

steps.content: At the bottom of the dropdown, click **Search More...**. A window opens with every journal.

content_i18n.en_US: At the bottom of the dropdown, click **Search More...**. A window opens with every journal.

steps.description: Check: the full list of journals is shown.

description_i18n.en_US: Check: the full list of journals is shown.

steps.title: Select Customer Receipts - Cash

title_i18n.en_US: Select Customer Receipts - Cash

steps.content: Click the row **Customer Receipts - Cash** (red box). If the customer paid by bank, choose the matching bank journal here instead (for example BOC BANK).

content_i18n.en_US: Click the row **Customer Receipts - Cash** (red box). If the customer paid by bank, choose the matching bank journal here instead (for example BOC BANK).

steps.description: Check: the Journal field shows "Customer Receipts - Cash". Watch out: choosing the wrong journal records the money in the wrong account.

description_i18n.en_US: Check: the Journal field shows "Customer Receipts - Cash". Watch out: choosing the wrong journal records the money in the wrong account.

steps.title: Click Create Payment to finish the payment

title_i18n.en_US: Click Create Payment to finish the payment

steps.content: Click **Create Payment** (red box). The window closes and the invoice is updated.

content_i18n.en_US: Click **Create Payment** (red box). The window closes and the invoice is updated.

steps.description: Check: the payment is registered on the invoice.

description_i18n.en_US: Check: the payment is registered on the invoice.

steps.title: Check the IN PAYMENT ribbon on the invoice

title_i18n.en_US: Check the IN PAYMENT ribbon on the invoice

steps.content: Look at the top right corner of the invoice. The green **IN PAYMENT** ribbon (red box) shows that the payment has been registered. The credit sale is now complete.

content_i18n.en_US: Look at the top right corner of the invoice. The green **IN PAYMENT** ribbon (red box) shows that the payment has been registered. The credit sale is now complete.

steps.description: Result: serial-number product delivered, customer invoiced on 14 Days credit terms, payment recorded. Tip: IN PAYMENT becomes **PAID** once the payment is matched with your cash or bank statement.

description_i18n.en_US: Result: serial-number product delivered, customer invoiced on 14 Days credit terms, payment recorded. Tip: IN PAYMENT becomes **PAID** once the payment is matched with your cash or bank statement.
